notes: Financial statements are scanned images; every page located by its heading or, for the sideways note 30.1, by its content (its totals equal the SCI). Units thousand Baht. Acquisition-cost amortisation includes the impairment of acquisition cash flows (a fifth expense line the template has no row for), as in the pilot. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. CSM future-service change = change in estimates + onerous-contract line (CSM column) + experience adjustment.
